descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
Keysfin is looking for a SQL Developer 
 Location: Bucharest 
 Our client is a product-driven software company with a web-based approach.
 The company’s vision is to provide customers with a modern, dynamic user interface management solution, developed using the latest technologies, that will reduce implementation time by over 70%.
 We are currently looking for a SQL Developer to join the team and contribute to the development, optimization, and maintenance of database solutions supporting web-based applications.
 Responsibilities: 
Develop and maintain current databases, stored procedures, functions, views, and SQL queries using Microsoft SQL Server
Design, develop, document new modules of the application
Develop and maintain SSRS reports
Optimize queries and database performance using execution plans, indexes, statistics, and Query Store
Troubleshoot database and application-related issues and support deployments and maintenance activities
Work with development, QA, and business teams to translate technical and functional requirements into database solutions
Document technical solutions and take ownership of assigned modules
 Ideal candidate: 
2+ years of experience with Microsoft SQL Server
Good knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and database design
Hands-on experience with stored procedures, functions, views, indexes, and query optimization
Experience with SSRS, SSIS and ETL processes experience is a plus
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work independently
Ability to understand technical requirements and collaborate effectively with development teams
University Degree in Computer Science, Informatics, Cybernetics, Telecommunications, or a related field
Good communication skills and team-player mindset.
Good English skills
 Technical skills: 
SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) and SQL Server Data Tools (SSDT)
SQL queries, Stored Procedures, Functions, Views, Triggers
Database design, indexing, execution plans, statistics, and Query Store
Transactions, locking, blocking, and database security
SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and ETL
SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)
SQL Server Agent
Git / TFS and source control
JSON / XML
 Nice to have: 
Develop and maintain ETL processes and SSIS packages
Azure SQL Database / Azure SQL Managed Instance
Azure Data Factory
Database migration and upgrade experience
CI/CD and database DevOps practices
PowerShell scripting and automation
Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery concepts
 Benefits: 
We believe in the Homework principle – we’ll make you feel at home and give you the opportunity to grow while working on challenging technical solutions
Cozy office close to the city center, less than 2 minutes from Eroilor Opera Center, with a beautiful garden, fresh fruit, tea, and coffee
BBQ parties, team outings, and a friendly working environment
Paid medical subscription to a private healthcare clinic
